title: Build an Email Response Library
description: Create a library of AI-crafted email templates for your most common email types — so you reply faster and more professionally.
steps: List your 5 most common email types (e.g. declining a meeting, following up on a proposal, handling a complaint)
For each type, write a base prompt: "Act as a professional communicator. Write a [type] email that is [tone]. Include: [key elements]. Keep it under 150 words."
Generate 2-3 variations per email type with different tones
Edit each template to match your actual voice and add your specific details
Save these as reusable snippets in your email client or a doc
expectedOutput: A library of 10-15 polished email templates ready to use with minimal editing.
bonusChallenges: Build a system prompt that encodes your full writing style and generates everything in your voice
Add a "difficult conversation" template for giving critical feedback professionally
